purpose: Teach: キルト/デッサン/ライフワーク/レインボー/ハヤカワ/ローソン/ベースボール/グリーンピース

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お母さんとキルトを縫った
lines.en: Gran, when she was young, your mother and I used to sew quilts together.
lines.style: Soft, distant voice. Opening note reaches back into memory. Slow pace, breath between phrases. Tender but matter-of-fact, like recounting something precious that's settled into bone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、デッサンを習われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and you learned sketching from Grandfather, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, gently correcting. Leans into the memory with him. Rhythmic, like she's been waiting to add her thread to his. Affectionate tone on the closing question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが研究をライフワークとされた
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father made research his life's work.
lines.style: Voice settles deeper. Quieter than before. Lets the weight of 'lifework' breathe. Pauses slightly after 'father' — giving the memory space. Barely a whisper at the trailing thought.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、雨上がりのレインボーをご覧になって喜ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandfather, you were so happy when you saw that rainbow after the rain, weren't you?
lines.style: Brighter now, lifting slightly. A small smile in the voice. She's coaxing him toward warmth, toward the smaller joys. Gentle insistence in 'weren't you' — checking that he remembers the light too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがハヤカワ文庫を集められた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father collected Hayakawa books — all of them.
lines.style: Voice quiets again, almost reverent. Opens with a slight hesitation, like touching something carefully. Lets 'collected' linger — a deliberate man, particular in his devotion. Slow, deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ローソンができた時驚かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather was quite amazed when that Lawson convenience store opened nearby, wasn't he?
lines.style: Gentle humor underneath. A small lift in tone — she's noticed his pattern, offering him moments of brightness alongside the weight. Warm and slightly playful, like she's been listening to him for decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがベースボールチームの応援団だった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father was part of the baseball team's cheering squad.
lines.style: Voice reaches back again, finding another thread. Warmth underneath the wistfulness — there's something alive in this memory. Steady pace. Lets 'cheering squad' carry a note of pride and community.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、グリーンピースの活動を見守られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you watched over the Greenpeace movement with such care, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Voice closes gently. Affirming, almost archival in tone. Slow final phrase. Soft landing on 'dear' — she's wrapping this moment with love. Breath trailing off, voice settling into quiet peace.
